name: SPY Technical Indicator Predictive Power Analysis
description: Research study testing the predictive power of multiple technical indicators (RSI, MACD, moving average crossovers, Bollinger Bands, volume) over 1-5 day forward return horizons
source:
# SPY Technical Indicator Predictive Power Analysis
# Research study testing predictive power of technical indicators

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# =============================================================================
# TECHNICAL INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# RSI (14-period)
rsi_value = rsi(period=14)(close)

# MACD (12, 26, 9)
macd_line, macd_signal, macd_hist = macd(short_period=12, long_period=26, signal_period=9)(close)

# Moving Averages (50 and 200 SMA)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2 std dev)
bb_lower, bb_middle, bb_upper = bbands(period=20, stddev=2)(close)

# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CONDITIONS
# =============================================================================

# RSI Signals
rsi_oversold = rsi_value < 30
rsi_overbought = rsi_value > 70

# MACD Crossover Signals
macd_bull_cross = crossover(macd_line, macd_signal)
macd_bear_cross = crossunder(macd_line, macd_signal)

# Moving Average Regime Signals
golden_regime = close > sma_50 and close > sma_200
death_regime = close < sma_50 and close < sma_200
above_50_below_200 = close > sma_50 and close < sma_200
below_50_above_200 = close < sma_50 and close > sma_200

# Bollinger Band Extreme Signals
bb_lower_extreme = close < bb_lower
bb_upper_extreme = close > bb_upper

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS
# =============================================================================

fwd_ret_1d = forward_returns(period=1)(close)
fwd_ret_3d = forward_returns(period=3)(close)
fwd_ret_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(close)

# Win flags (positive returns)
win_1d = fwd_ret_1d > 0
win_3d = fwd_ret_3d > 0
win_5d = fwd_ret_5d > 0

# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL-FILTERED RETURNS AND WINS
# =============================================================================

# RSI Oversold filtered returns
rsi_os_ret_1d = where(rsi_oversold, fwd_ret_1d)
rsi_os_ret_3d = where(rsi_oversold, fwd_ret_3d)
rsi_os_ret_5d = where(rsi_oversold, fwd_ret_5d)
rsi_os_win_1d = where(rsi_oversold, win_1d)
rsi_os_win_3d = where(rsi_oversold, win_3d)
rsi_os_win_5d = where(rsi_oversold, win_5d)

# RSI Overbought filtered returns
rsi_ob_ret_1d = where(rsi_overbought, fwd_ret_1d)
rsi_ob_ret_3d = where(rsi_overbought, fwd_ret_3d)
rsi_ob_ret_5d = where(rsi_overbought, fwd_ret_5d)
rsi_ob_win_1d = where(rsi_overbought, win_1d)
rsi_ob_win_3d = where(rsi_overbought, win_3d)
rsi_ob_win_5d = where(rsi_overbought, win_5d)

# MACD Bullish Cross filtered returns
macd_bull_ret_1d = where(macd_bull_cross, fwd_ret_1d)
macd_bull_ret_3d = where(macd_bull_cross, fwd_ret_3d)
macd_bull_ret_5d = where(macd_bull_cross, fwd_ret_5d)
macd_bull_win_1d = where(macd_bull_cross, win_1d)
macd_bull_win_3d = where(macd_bull_cross, win_3d)
macd_bull_win_5d = where(macd_bull_cross, win_5d)

# MACD Bearish Cross filtered returns
macd_bear_ret_1d = where(macd_bear_cross, fwd_ret_1d)
macd_bear_ret_3d = where(macd_bear_cross, fwd_ret_3d)
macd_bear_ret_5d = where(macd_bear_cross, fwd_ret_5d)
macd_bear_win_1d = where(macd_bear_cross, win_1d)
macd_bear_win_3d = where(macd_bear_cross, win_3d)
macd_bear_win_5d = where(macd_bear_cross, win_5d)

# Golden Regime filtered returns
golden_ret_1d = where(golden_regime, fwd_ret_1d)
golden_ret_3d = where(golden_regime, fwd_ret_3d)
golden_ret_5d = where(golden_regime, fwd_ret_5d)
golden_win_1d = where(golden_regime, win_1d)
golden_win_3d = where(golden_regime, win_3d)
golden_win_5d = where(golden_regime, win_5d)

# BB Lower Extreme filtered returns
bb_low_ret_1d = where(bb_lower_extreme, fwd_ret_1d)
bb_low_ret_3d = where(bb_lower_extreme, fwd_ret_3d)
bb_low_ret_5d = where(bb_lower_extreme, fwd_ret_5d)
bb_low_win_1d = where(bb_lower_extreme, win_1d)
bb_low_win_3d = where(bb_lower_extreme, win_3d)
bb_low_win_5d = where(bb_lower_extreme, win_5d)

# BB Upper Extreme filtered returns
bb_up_ret_1d = where(bb_upper_extreme, fwd_ret_1d)
bb_up_ret_3d = where(bb_upper_extreme, fwd_ret_3d)
bb_up_ret_5d = where(bb_upper_extreme, fwd_ret_5d)
bb_up_win_1d = where(bb_upper_extreme, win_1d)
bb_up_win_3d = where(bb_upper_extreme, win_3d)
bb_up_win_5d = where(bb_upper_extreme, win_5d)

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURNS FOR EQUITY CURVES
# =============================================================================

# RSI Oversold cumulative return
rsi_os_cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(coalesce(rsi_os_ret_1d, 0))

# MACD crossover cumulative returns
macd_bull_cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(coalesce(macd_bull_ret_1d, 0))
macd_bear_cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(coalesce(macd_bear_ret_1d, 0))

# BB extreme cumulative returns
bb_low_cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(coalesce(bb_low_ret_1d, 0))
bb_up_cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(coalesce(bb_up_ret_1d, 0))

# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL COUNTS (for numeric aggregation)
# =============================================================================
rsi_os_count = 1.0 if rsi_oversold else 0.0
rsi_ob_count = 1.0 if rsi_overbought else 0.0
macd_bull_count = 1.0 if macd_bull_cross else 0.0
macd_bear_count = 1.0 if macd_bear_cross else 0.0
golden_count = 1.0 if golden_regime else 0.0
bb_low_count = 1.0 if bb_lower_extreme else 0.0
bb_up_count = 1.0 if bb_upper_extreme else 0.0

# Win rate conversion to numeric
rsi_os_win_1d_num = 1.0 if rsi_os_win_1d else 0.0
rsi_os_win_5d_num = 1.0 if rsi_os_win_5d else 0.0
rsi_ob_win_1d_num = 1.0 if rsi_ob_win_1d else 0.0
macd_bull_win_1d_num = 1.0 if macd_bull_win_1d else 0.0
macd_bull_win_5d_num = 1.0 if macd_bull_win_5d else 0.0
golden_win_1d_num = 1.0 if golden_win_1d else 0.0
bb_low_win_1d_num = 1.0 if bb_low_win_1d else 0.0
bb_low_win_5d_num = 1.0 if bb_low_win_5d else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CARDS
# =============================================================================

# RSI Oversold (1D) Card
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="RSI Oversold (1D)",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Signal Performance"
)(rsi_os_win_1d_num, rsi_os_ret_1d)

# RSI Oversold (5D) Card
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="RSI Oversold (5D)",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Signal Performance"
)(rsi_os_win_5d_num, rsi_os_ret_5d)

# RSI Overbought (1D) Card
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="RSI Overbought (1D)",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Signal Performance"
)(rsi_ob_win_1d_num, rsi_ob_ret_1d)

# MACD Bullish Cross (1D) Card
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="MACD Bullish Cross (1D)",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Signal Performance"
)(macd_bull_win_1d_num, macd_bull_ret_1d)

# MACD Bullish Cross (5D) Card
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="MACD Bullish Cross (5D)",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Signal Performance"
)(macd_bull_win_5d_num, macd_bull_ret_5d)

# Golden Regime (1D) Card
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Golden Regime (1D)",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Signal Performance"
)(golden_win_1d_num, golden_ret_1d)

# BB Lower Extreme (1D) Card
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="BB Lower Extreme (1D)",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Signal Performance"
)(bb_low_win_1d_num, bb_low_ret_1d)

# BB Lower Extreme (5D) Card
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="BB Lower Extreme (5D)",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Win Rate", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Signal Performance"
)(bb_low_win_5d_num, bb_low_ret_5d)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD TABLES
# =============================================================================

# Signal Performance Summary Table
detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Signal Performance Summary",
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Count", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Win Rate", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Avg Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="3D Win Rate", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="3D Avg Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="5D Win Rate", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="5D Avg Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Show", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    ),
    category="Analysis Tables"
)(
    "RSI Oversold" if rsi_oversold else ("RSI Overbought" if rsi_overbought else ("MACD Bull" if macd_bull_cross else ("MACD Bear" if macd_bear_cross else ("Golden" if golden_regime else ("BB Lower" if bb_lower_extreme else ("BB Upper" if bb_upper_extreme else "None")))))),
    rsi_os_count + rsi_ob_count + macd_bull_count + macd_bear_count + golden_count + bb_low_count + bb_up_count,
    coalesce(rsi_os_win_1d_num, coalesce(rsi_ob_win_1d_num, coalesce(macd_bull_win_1d_num, coalesce(where(macd_bear_cross, 1.0 if win_1d else 0.0), coalesce(golden_win_1d_num, coalesce(bb_low_win_1d_num, where(bb_upper_extreme, 1.0 if win_1d else 0.0))))))),
    coalesce(rsi_os_ret_1d, coalesce(rsi_ob_ret_1d, coalesce(macd_bull_ret_1d, coalesce(macd_bear_ret_1d, coalesce(golden_ret_1d, coalesce(bb_low_ret_1d, bb_up_ret_1d)))))),
    coalesce(rsi_os_win_3d, coalesce(rsi_ob_win_3d, coalesce(macd_bull_win_3d, coalesce(macd_bear_win_3d, coalesce(golden_win_3d, coalesce(bb_low_win_3d, bb_up_win_3d)))))),
    coalesce(rsi_os_ret_3d, coalesce(rsi_ob_ret_3d, coalesce(macd_bull_ret_3d, coalesce(macd_bear_ret_3d, coalesce(golden_ret_3d, coalesce(bb_low_ret_3d, bb_up_ret_3d)))))),
    coalesce(rsi_os_win_5d, coalesce(rsi_ob_win_5d, coalesce(macd_bull_win_5d, coalesce(macd_bear_win_5d, coalesce(golden_win_5d, coalesce(bb_low_win_5d, bb_up_win_5d)))))),
    coalesce(rsi_os_ret_5d, coalesce(rsi_ob_ret_5d, coalesce(macd_bull_ret_5d, coalesce(macd_bear_ret_5d, coalesce(golden_ret_5d, coalesce(bb_low_ret_5d, bb_up_ret_5d)))))),
    rsi_oversold or rsi_overbought or macd_bull_cross or macd_bear_cross or golden_regime or bb_lower_extreme or bb_upper_extreme
)

# Detailed RSI Signal Analysis Table
detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Detailed RSI Signal Analysis",
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Condition", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="3D Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="5D Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI Value", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Show", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    ),
    category="Analysis Tables"
)(
    "Oversold" if rsi_oversold else ("Overbought" if rsi_overbought else "Neutral"),
    coalesce(rsi_os_ret_1d, rsi_ob_ret_1d),
    coalesce(rsi_os_ret_3d, rsi_ob_ret_3d),
    coalesce(rsi_os_ret_5d, rsi_ob_ret_5d),
    rsi_value,
    rsi_oversold or rsi_overbought
)

# MACD Crossover Analysis Table
detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="MACD Crossover Analysis",
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="3D Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="5D Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="MACD", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Show", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    ),
    category="Analysis Tables"
)(
    "Bullish Cross" if macd_bull_cross else ("Bearish Cross" if macd_bear_cross else "No Signal"),
    coalesce(macd_bull_ret_1d, macd_bear_ret_1d),
    coalesce(macd_bull_ret_3d, macd_bear_ret_3d),
    coalesce(macd_bull_ret_5d, macd_bear_ret_5d),
    macd_line,
    macd_bull_cross or macd_bear_cross
)

# Moving Average Regime Analysis Table
detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Moving Average Regime Analysis",
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Regime", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="5D Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Price", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="SMA 50", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="SMA 200", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Analysis Tables"
)(
    "Golden (Above Both)" if golden_regime else ("Death (Below Both)" if death_regime else ("Above 50 Only" if above_50_below_200 else ("Above 200 Only" if below_50_above_200 else "Mixed"))),
    fwd_ret_1d,
    fwd_ret_5d,
    close,
    sma_50,
    sma_200
)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CHARTS - BAR CHARTS
# =============================================================================

# 1-Day Forward Win Rates by Signal
xy_bars(
    title="1-Day Forward Win Rates by Signal",
    category="Win Rate Charts",
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label="Win Rate",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="RSI Oversold", color=Color.Emerald),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="RSI Overbought", color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="MACD Bull", color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="MACD Bear", color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Golden Regime", color=Color.Gold),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="BB Lower", color=Color.Cyan),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="BB Upper", color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(rsi_os_win_1d_num, rsi_ob_win_1d_num, macd_bull_win_1d_num, where(macd_bear_cross, 1.0 if win_1d else 0.0), golden_win_1d_num, bb_low_win_1d_num, where(bb_upper_extreme, 1.0 if win_1d else 0.0))

# 5-Day Forward Win Rates by Signal
xy_bars(
    title="5-Day Forward Win Rates by Signal",
    category="Win Rate Charts",
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label="Win Rate",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name="RSI Oversold", color=Color.Emerald),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="RSI Overbought", color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="MACD Bull", color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="MACD Bear", color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="Golden Regime", color=Color.Gold),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="BB Lower", color=Color.Cyan),
        BarSeriesSpec(name="BB Upper", color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(rsi_os_win_5d_num, where(rsi_overbought, 1.0 if win_5d else 0.0), macd_bull_win_5d_num, where(macd_bear_cross, 1.0 if win_5d else 0.0), where(golden_regime, 1.0 if win_5d else 0.0), bb_low_win_5d_num, where(bb_upper_extreme, 1.0 if win_5d else 0.0))

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CHARTS - LINE CHARTS
# =============================================================================

# RSI Oversold Signal Equity Curve
timeseries_lines(
    title="RSI Oversold Signal Equity Curve",
    category="Equity Curves",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="RSI Oversold Cumulative Return", color=Color.Emerald)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(rsi_os_cum_ret)

# MACD Crossover Equity Curves
timeseries_lines(
    title="MACD Crossover Equity Curves",
    category="Equity Curves",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="MACD Bullish Cross", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="MACD Bearish Cross", color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(macd_bull_cum_ret, macd_bear_cum_ret)

# BB Extreme Signal Equity Curves
timeseries_lines(
    title="BB Extreme Signal Equity Curves",
    category="Equity Curves",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BB Lower Extreme", color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BB Upper Extreme", color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(bb_low_cum_ret, bb_up_cum_ret)

# Signal Frequency Over Time
timeseries_lines(
    title="Signal Frequency Over Time",
    category="Signal Analysis",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="RSI Oversold", color=Color.Emerald),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="RSI Overbought", color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="MACD Bull Cross", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="BB Lower Extreme", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(rsi_os_count, rsi_ob_count, macd_bull_count, bb_low_count)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# RSI Oversold Event Marker
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="RSI Oversold",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI Value", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Fwd Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(rsi_value, close, fwd_ret_1d, rsi_oversold)

# RSI Overbought Event Marker
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="RSI Overbought",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="RSI Value", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Fwd Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(rsi_value, close, fwd_ret_1d, rsi_overbought)

# MACD Bullish Cross Event Marker
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="MACD Bullish Cross",
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="MACD", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Fwd Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(macd_line, macd_signal, close, fwd_ret_1d, macd_bull_cross)

# BB Lower Extreme Event Marker
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="BB Lower Extreme",
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="BB Lower", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="BB Upper", type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="1D Fwd Ret", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Filter", table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(close, bb_lower, bb_upper, fwd_ret_1d, bb_lower_extreme)
